summary.text: John LaHood, a Republican, represents Georgia House District 175 after winning a special election in February 2018; he was sworn in on February 19, 2018.

paragraphs.text: He chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Transportation.
LaHood is owner and president of Fellowship Senior Living, Inc., and describes himself in his official biography as a third-generation owner and operator of senior living communities.
